limits: Local checkpoint recovery restores recorded analysis settings and attached completed result files, not original receptor/expression sources, separate unattached parents, reference installations, running jobs or a whole library. It performs no scientific recomputation. Exact certificate replay remains limited to the published per-kind support matrix. Recorded differences are descriptive, not effects, significance or biological validation. Evidence can contain identifiers, sequences and paths; it is not de-identified or a redistribution license.
